token-v1.name: ERC-20 Token
token-v1.description: A fixed-supply ERC-20 token with an owner. No post-deploy minting.

constructorParams.name: name
constructorParams.label: Token Name
constructorParams.description: Display name of the token (e.g. CommunityCoin)

constructorParams.name: owner
constructorParams.label: Owner Address
constructorParams.description: Address that receives the minted supply. Defaults to your wallet.

escrow-v1.name: Escrow
escrow-v1.description: Two-party escrow. Supports arbiter-controlled release or time-locked automatic release.

constructorParams.name: arbiter
constructorParams.label: Arbiter Address
constructorParams.description: Mediator address (required for ARBITER_RELEASE; use 0x0 for TIMELOCK)

constructorParams.name: timelockDuration
constructorParams.label: Timelock Duration (s)
constructorParams.description: Seconds until anyone can release (TIMELOCK mode only; 0 for ARBITER_RELEASE)

multisig-v1.name: Multisig Wallet
multisig-v1.description: M-of-N multisig wallet. Requires threshold confirmations to execute transactions.

constructorParams.name: signers
constructorParams.label: Signer Addresses
constructorParams.description: List of wallet addresses that can sign (minimum 2, no duplicates)

constructorParams.name: threshold
constructorParams.label: Threshold
constructorParams.description: Number of confirmations required to execute (1 ≤ threshold ≤ signers.length)
